content: Three types of models were used in our system, a feed-forward neural network, an LSTM network and an SVM regressor. The neural nets were inspired by the work of Prayas BIBREF7 in the previous shared task. Different regression algorithms (e.g. AdaBoost, XGBoost) were also tried due to the success of SeerNet BIBREF8 , but our study was not able to reproduce their results for Spanish.
